class="article page no-article-survey" sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Create an illustrated storybook in Gemini Apps</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><div>You can create a storybook from a text prompt or using your own photos in Gemini Apps. You can also have Gemini read the story aloud.
<h2>What you need</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ul class="no-margin">
  <li>For now, this feature isn’t available to users under 18 years old.</li>
</ul>

<div class="no-margin"><p>To use this feature, you must be signed in to Gemini Apps. <a href="/gemini/answer/13278668" rel="noopener">Learn how to sign in to Gemini Apps</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<gkms-context-selector id="16435428"></gkms-context-selector><h2>Create a storybook</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>Go to <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">gemini.google.com</a>.</li>
  <li>On the left under <strong>Gems</strong>, click Storybook.
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Tip:</strong> If you don’t find Storybook, click Explore Gems&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/Pwnkf7kO0dqxpvPvUpGTt33VSuRZMgLcc41eC43ayAk4NH3AeYnORu5LFI2TEj4qsnk">&nbsp;to find the complete list of Gems.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>In the text box, enter a prompt of the story you want to generate.
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Optional:</strong> To upload your own photos or files for Gemini to use in your story, click Add files&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc">. <a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/14903178"><u>Learn more about uploading files in Gemini Apps</u></a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Click Submit <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/g2svh5vRbDsKjL_bYZLtRARtJ9sd-qFGFI_ikEx9E6uMiw-ozJbf412dACT0za2X-To=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/g2svh5vRbDsKjL_bYZLtRARtJ9sd-qFGFI_ikEx9E6uMiw-ozJbf412dACT0za2X-To">.
    <ul>
      <li>When your storybook is ready, it will open in the panel on the right.&nbsp;</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ol>
</div>
<a class="zippy" id="storybook_prompts" name="storybook_prompts">More ways you can start a storybook</a>

<div><p>In addition to the Storybook Gem, you can start a storybook:</p>

<h4><strong>With a prompt in a new chat</strong></h4>

<p>In the text box, start your prompt with “Create a storybook about” and add your desired topic.</p>

<p>To start a storybook through a text prompt, “storybook” must be entered in English.</p>

<h4><strong>With an uploaded image</strong></h4>

<ol>
  <li>In the text box at the bottom, click Add files&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/ZnxIaQhn2e_7LrN9FuAXtp5YSjXPfkqyIdYba4XV438cpOg3dPV0X00A52NEtfgJVqc">.&nbsp;<a href="https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/14903178"><u>Learn more about uploading files in Gemini Apps</u></a>.</li>
  <li>Select the photo(s) you want Gemini to use to create your storybook.</li>
  <li>Below the text box, click Create a storybook&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/yHy6jNKmkJu8u9tIvTc3Mg_mfpuzsKjKjoEOiXga9i5z424QqSn1sEw6GaoWEsEFxh4=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/yHy6jNKmkJu8u9tIvTc3Mg_mfpuzsKjKjoEOiXga9i5z424QqSn1sEw6GaoWEsEFxh4">.</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="no-margin"><p><strong>Tips:&nbsp;</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>It may take 1–2 minutes for the storybook to be created.</li>
  <li>Storybooks generated in Gemini Apps are usually&nbsp; 10-12 pages.</li>
  <li>To regenerate your story, in the text box on the left, tell Gemini what changes you want to make and Gemini will create a new version of the story.</li>
  <li>To view your saved versions, at the top, click Previous Version&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/4K_HRzHJAb2EFmlMmS8EjxBLIAFJh4K5GmFwP_j1r6crLFQjVlSHJDLOgiyhM6riT4w=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/4K_HRzHJAb2EFmlMmS8EjxBLIAFJh4K5GmFwP_j1r6crLFQjVlSHJDLOgiyhM6riT4w">&nbsp;or Next Version&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/dEY2XgoWxb1ObQN1vNULSwPx2rxcsp6M9V59FdpmcEa5rE_SJGQUIlLGr_cgyncLNHk=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/dEY2XgoWxb1ObQN1vNULSwPx2rxcsp6M9V59FdpmcEa5rE_SJGQUIlLGr_cgyncLNHk">.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2>Interact with a storybook</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>At the top of the storybook, find options for how you can interact with the book.</p>

<ul>
  <li>To view the storybook in full screen, click Full screen <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9OZBla1K9kMzL00GHxeXKLHi79dZIieWgR1-ajCKXuXIjD6XaRa1NQOpx8eJ8Vofp7Q=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/9OZBla1K9kMzL00GHxeXKLHi79dZIieWgR1-ajCKXuXIjD6XaRa1NQOpx8eJ8Vofp7Q">.</li>
  <li>To go to the next page, click next&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/upHcTLgeKQpKOmyRJSAZ5jX-Ki3JvFgZ9uknaOhKSCKEfvcu_eF6gHkOqy0Y396hw80i=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/upHcTLgeKQpKOmyRJSAZ5jX-Ki3JvFgZ9uknaOhKSCKEfvcu_eF6gHkOqy0Y396hw80i"> or the lower right corner of the book.</li>
  <li>To go to the previous page, click back <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/sQiNEPDYE70SJrwDKx2b0ygNTNC5NNSYS0wCyrAZG2s1ImJuELB65UV-C-vG_ESswTc=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/sQiNEPDYE70SJrwDKx2b0ygNTNC5NNSYS0wCyrAZG2s1ImJuELB65UV-C-vG_ESswTc">&nbsp;or the lower left corner of the book.</li>
  <li>To jump to the beginning or end, click the page number to pull up options:
    <ul>
      <li>To go to the beginning, click Jump to beginning <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/RSh-wCDQlaL2YAjy_csqAjGA7tAjV4tqLYxFDFOmEds73taAgrr6i7-4frUiBF_edhE=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/RSh-wCDQlaL2YAjy_csqAjGA7tAjV4tqLYxFDFOmEds73taAgrr6i7-4frUiBF_edhE">.</li>
      <li>To go to the end, click Jump to end <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/0r1GkXMtjww2d-qh0n1A4aD42tR5G6AZ1AdmNX5_cHvTgFIxyZQENCdLfa4Z2Q9j0Qs=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/0r1GkXMtjww2d-qh0n1A4aD42tR5G6AZ1AdmNX5_cHvTgFIxyZQENCdLfa4Z2Q9j0Qs">.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>To listen to the book, click Listen <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/H95mFKkV89QTikFM8-VVt2FGpKcNbvgjDs-csZhalothmSfk3CLaBQMxaIbMrwxhYQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/H95mFKkV89QTikFM8-VVt2FGpKcNbvgjDs-csZhalothmSfk3CLaBQMxaIbMrwxhYQ">.
    <ul>
      <li><strong>Tip:</strong> You can also change the voice reading the storybook. To change the voice, next to Listen, click&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/xdfWSDT387DHqxoYKiDMoxCLFEAWh8kqeDovwcwzyCx56GP6TWewf5Gri3RCQULFcYo=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/xdfWSDT387DHqxoYKiDMoxCLFEAWh8kqeDovwcwzyCx56GP6TWewf5Gri3RCQULFcYo"> and select a different voice.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
</ul>
</div>

<h2><a id="share_storybook" name="share_storybook">Share, print, or download a storybook&nbsp;</a></h2>

<h3>Share a public link to a storybook</h3>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>At the top, click Share&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;Share <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA">.</li>
  <li>Next to the <code>g.co/gemini/share</code> link, click Copy link&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/R3rajf4zLqVR7rsKlEZA7UOxKS2vVmvnClqoMv89rZ8QhD6OqBvz5s3G1OwpTZSRwXQ=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/R3rajf4zLqVR7rsKlEZA7UOxKS2vVmvnClqoMv89rZ8QhD6OqBvz5s3G1OwpTZSRwXQ">. Then paste it where you want to share, like in a messaging app, an email draft, or a forum thread.</li>
</ol>

<p><a href="/gemini/answer/13743730" rel="noopener"><u>Learn more about sharing chats from Gemini Apps</u></a>.</p>
</div>

<h3 class="no-margin"><a id="print_storybook" name="print_storybook">Print a storybook&nbsp;or save it as a PDF</a></h3>

<div class="no-margin"><ol>
  <li>At the top, click Share&nbsp;<img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/QqVZ3ESyW-OTWnmILv3irGUfGmphnn35oCcv4o0W5nsOc8MSu4zr0RRUoY-6TnY9XcA"> <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="and then" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/3_l97rr0GvhSP2XV5OoCkV2ZDTIisAOczrSdzNCBxhIKWrjXjHucxNwocghoUa39gw">&nbsp;Print <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lN5gEBqScHejiDO1Agzavixyz9_59Sw00LhgKGbvmduN8KWvxUPXX3WQho5KLzYN1PA=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/lN5gEBqScHejiDO1Agzavixyz9_59Sw00LhgKGbvmduN8KWvxUPXX3WQho5KLzYN1PA">.
    <ul>
      <li>If you have pop-ups blocked, you may be asked to allow pop-ups from <a href="https://gemini.google.com" rel="noopener">gemini.google.com</a> in your browser. Steps to allow pop-ups may differ by browser. <a href="/chrome/answer/95472#Allow_popups" rel="noopener">Learn how to allow pop-ups from a site in Google Chrome</a>.</li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li>Follow onscreen instructions.</li>
</ol>

<p dir="ltr"><strong>Tip:</strong> You can also create a PDF of your storybook by selecting “Save as PDF” in your print options.</p>
</div>

<div class="no-margin">&nbsp;</div>

<h2 class="no-margin">How to report offensive or unsafe content</h2>

<div class="no-margin"><p>If you find a storybook offensive or unsafe, you can report the content.</p>

<ol>
  <li>Open the storybook.&nbsp;</li>
  <li>On the bottom of the cover page, click <strong>Report content</strong>.</li>
</ol>
<a href="/gemini/answer/13594961#feedback" rel="noopener"><u>Learn how Google uses your feedback</u></a>.</div>
